Parents first

The six questions every parent asks us.

No brochure hunting and no phone calls needed. Every answer below is one click away, with the exact numbers.

Fees

What will a year actually cost?

Tuition ₹18,000–₹24,000 a year, plus a one-time ₹5,000 admission fee. Books, uniform and transport listed separately — nothing hidden.

See the full fee table
Results

How do students actually do?

95% overall board pass rate, 100% results in Class 10 English and Science, and district-level science exhibition selections.

See academics
Transport

Does the bus reach my village?

Safe transport across a 15 km radius of Amet, including Khempur, Parasoli, Devgarh Road and Railmagra. ₹800–₹1,200 a month.

Check the routes
Teachers

Will my child get attention?

Every teacher is B.Ed qualified with at least 5 years of experience. 1:25 in primary, and free remedial classes after school for children who need them.

Meet the teachers
English

Will my child speak English confidently?

The only English-medium school within 10 km of Amet. The LEAD English programme adds weekly speaking practice, reading circles and debate.

How LEAD works
Seats

Are seats still available?

Nursery to Class 9 are open at 30 seats per class. Class 10 is full. No entrance test, and a decision inside one week.

Start an enquiry
